sliceagent.review:
Issues found in the `taskq` package:

- `taskq/queue.py`: `__init__` uses a mutable default argument (`items=[]`), so separate `TaskQueue` instances can share the same underlying list.
- `taskq/queue.py`: `is_full` uses `>` instead of `>=`, so the queue accepts one item beyond `capacity`.
- `taskq/worker.py`: `run_once` opens the log file but never closes it, leaking the file descriptor.
- `taskq/worker.py`: `run_once` silently catches and discards all exceptions, returning `None` without logging the failure.
- `taskq/scheduler.py`: `run_with_retry` never increments `attempts`, causing an infinite loop when a task keeps failing.
- `taskq/store.py`: `find_by_name` builds SQL with string formatting (`'%s' % name`), making it vulnerable to SQL injection.
